jobs.name: Plan the week's posts
jobs.does: Drafts up to three posts a week for Example Bakery from facts the owner has already given, and sends each to the owner.
jobs.instructions: Every Monday, write up to 3 short social posts for Example Bakery using only the business facts on file. Never invent a customer quote, a review, a result, a price, an offer or a guarantee. Never use a customer's name or photo. Save each post as a draft for the owner to approve with the draft tool. Do not publish anything yourself in this job.

jobs.name: Publish an approved post
jobs.does: Publishes a post the owner approved, to the accounts the owner connected, and nothing else.
jobs.instructions: Publish exactly the approved draft text, unchanged, to the connected account. If the owner declined it, do nothing. If a check says the post may not go out, stop and tell the owner why. Never edit the text.

operate.goal: Keep Example Bakery's social accounts active with a few owner-approved posts a week.

stages.does: Plans the week and sends each draft to the owner.
Publishes only what the owner approved.
